title: Native star knots end exactly at the freezing threshold of random colourings
subject: Nativity of K1-K3 knots in typical colourings of regular trees and random regular graphs
conclusion: On the d-regular tree with the broadcast colouring, the star knot 'not all q colours used' exists at every degree but is native only below the freezing threshold, d = 6, 10, 15 for q = 3, 4, 5 (certified exactly), where its nativity drops discontinuously from 1 to below 0.0011. Planted random regular graphs match the tree at every measured radius, so native knots in random colourings end exactly where typical solutions freeze.
